name: Seed Junky | 1g Pre-Roll | Hollywood Pure Kush
description: Seed Junky Chocolatte eighth is a rich and indulgent smoke that lives up to its dessert-inspired name. The aroma greets you with deep notes of cocoa, roasted coffee, and sweet earth, underscored by a hint of creamy vanilla. On the palate, it delivers a smooth blend of mocha and subtle spice, with a velvety texture that lingers on the exhale. The experience is equally balanced—beginning with an uplifting cerebral buzz that enhances mood and creativity, followed by a warm, soothing body relaxation that makes it ideal for day-to-evening enjoyment.
